name: Music Gen
description: Generate music from a description and optional lyrics: with OAIY's engine (service engine:music), a service you add, or an ACE-Step / HeartMuLa server at API URL.
doc:
Generate AI music from text prompts using ACE-Step.

Prompt Tips:
• Include genre: pop, rock, electronic, jazz
• Specify mood: energetic, calm, melancholic
• Add instruments: piano, guitar, synth
• Describe vocals: male/female, soft, powerful

Lyrics Format:
[verse] First verse lyrics here
[chorus] Catchy chorus lyrics
[bridge] Bridge section

Settings:
• Duration: 10-240 seconds
• Quality Steps: higher = better but slower
• Seed: use same seed for reproducible results

Service: `OAIY engine` uses the music model set up in OAIY's Engines (songs with vocals; no lyrics makes an instrumental). Your own services (a Python rig in OAIY → Services, or a custom HTTP service) are sent `{{prompt}}`, `{{lyrics}}`, `{{duration}}`, `{{instrumental}}` and `{{seed}}`. `ACE-Step` / `HeartMuLa` call that server at API URL (default: localhost:8766).

inputs.name: Lyrics
inputs.description: Song lyrics with structure markers like [verse], [chorus]

inputs.name: Duration
inputs.description: Duration in seconds (overrides property if connected)

outputs.name: Path
outputs.description: File path to generated audio (for FFmpeg operations)

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which model or service makes the music. Add models in OAIY's Engines, or your own services (Python rigs) in OAIY's Services.

properties.name: API URL
properties.description: The ACE-Step / HeartMuLa server (used only when Service is one of them)

properties.name: Prompt
properties.default: pop, energetic, catchy melody, female vocal
properties.description: Music style tags (genre, mood, instruments, vocals)

properties.name: Duration (seconds)
properties.description: Length of the music in seconds (ACE-Step: 10-240; OAIY engine: up to 360)

properties.name: Quality Steps
properties.description: More steps = higher quality but slower

properties.name: Guidance Scale
properties.description: How closely to follow the prompt
